info.name: Project Service - Project CRUD
info.description:
Sample requests/responses CRUD proyek pada project-service (satu-satunya owner tabel content_detail_projects).

Membuat proyek di sini otomatis membuatnya tampil sebagai konten di public-content-service (listing type=project, is_publicated=true).

Semua endpoint admin, dilindungi JWT (Authorization: Bearer) + role super_admin/admin_pusat/admin_pustik.

Base URL local dev: http://localhost:4076/project-service/api

Endpoints:
1. GET    /projects                 - list proyek (paginated, cari via ?search=, filter kolom title & project_no)
2. POST   /projects                 - buat proyek (content_id opsional, otomatis dari contents type=project bila kosong)
3. GET    /projects/{project_id}    - detail proyek (relasi PM + additional content + tag)
4. PUT    /projects/{project_id}    - update proyek (parsial, null dilewati)
5. DELETE /projects/{project_id}    - hapus proyek (hanya status draft, soft delete)

variable.description: opsional - id contents type=project; kosongkan untuk auto-detect
